title: Vegetarian Roasted Mediterranean Gratin
description: A flavorful and satisfying vegetarian gratin filled with roasted vegetables, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Brush the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil.
Arrange the long beans in the baking dish.
Top the beans with the roasted red peppers, olives, and garlic.
Sprinkle the Mediterranean seasoning over the top.
Combine the grated cheese and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl.
Pour the cheese mixture over the vegetables.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
